# Getting help

Start with the [quickstart](../docs/quickstart.md), [configuration guide](../docs/configuration.md)
and [operations guide](../docs/operations.md). For missing metrics, inspect
`pulse doctor --json` and probe only the affected source/group.

File ordinary bugs and feature requests using the issue forms. Include the exact
commit, runtime, source group, date convention and a synthetic reproduction.
Remove private query terms, credentials, cookies, database paths and real reports.
A public issue is not a place to store provider account diagnostics.

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Ponchia/bronto-pulse/security/advisories/new)
for security defects. There is no hosted support SLA or managed service; this is
a source preview maintained by Ponchia.
